faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.q1: How can I create a new contract?
faq.a1: Log into your dashboard, click 'New Contract' and select your desired template.
faq.q2: Is the digital signature legally valid?
faq.a2: Yes, digital signatures in TruLink are valid according to e-commerce laws.
faq.q3: How do I invite the other party to the contract?
faq.a3: After creating the contract, you can send the unique link via email or SMS.
faq.a4: As long as the contract is not signed, editing is possible.
